The '''wraithwatch''' was a shift at a munitions factory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], which the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] worked at while undercover on the world during [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. The shift took place during the middle third of Darkknell's twenty four hour night, and was the only shift at the factory which saw no daylight at all, regardless of the season.
